PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Composite Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   B. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

6. When learning Plain Scale Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plain Scale Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plain Scale Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plain Scale Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Plain Scale Drawing.

7. When learning Computer Software, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Software.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Software.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Software.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Software.

8. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

9. When learning Cutting Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plane Geometry.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plane Geometry.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Plane Geometry.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plane Geometry.

12. When learning Data Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Safety.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cutting Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Software and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Bookkeeping 12 5.2 Income and Budgeting 9 5.3 Marketing goods and Services 8 5.4 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
